ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 85% of the visible surface with low-intensity (black) pixels forming a continuous border along the trailing edge and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous high-intensity white zone occupying central and lower fluke regions. High-contrast black banding follows the trailing edge. Low-contrast tan mottled blobs are distributed in the lower-central areas of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp apex and an approximate 45-degree angle of divergence between the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged topography along the trailing edge with frequent low-to-medium amplitude pixel variations (serrations). A distinct wide indentation is visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curvature of the trailing edge leading to elevated, tapered lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, heterogeneous brown/tan pixel groups at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. A single small, dark high-contrast spot is present in the upper-mid region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant clusters of biofouling on both distal tips; multiple small irregular notches along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely pronounced upward sweep of the fluke tips, creating a sharp crescent-shaped profile.
